name: Bills list (member read-only + payer attribution)
hostSurface: Web bills page + BillsBudgetCard; iOS BillsListViewModel; Android bills list.
purpose: Let a co-resident see the household's bills and see who paid what, so two people do not pay the same bill.
contents: finance.view read-only list (no Mark paid), payer attribution on the row, highlight-from-notification support (already present on web via highlightBillId), and rows that open the bill detail rather than writing from the list.
visualization: Row grammar: provider, amount, due date, status chip, and 'Paid by Sam · Sep 15' as the secondary line — the attribution is what gives the push an in-app twin.
uxNote: Keep mark-paid semantics identical everywhere it exists, or remove the write from glanceable surfaces entirely: a mis-tap on a card the user was skimming should not mark a household bill paid and notify everyone.
